scientific_integrity: Proof over all stated primes and algebraic closures uses coefficient identities and stable Cartier cycles; exact finite checks supplement the proof. Earlier isogeny decomposition and superspecial criterion are cited, not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Geometric p-rank only, all smooth parameters in characteristic p>=13; no complete root-intersection classification for arbitrary p, Newton polygons, Ekedahl--Oort types, rational-parameter census, or isomorphism-class census. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Three reduced Cartier rank-drop divisors on a genus-five dihedral family
